next.reason: 1985: "truncated from the right until it is equal to the number of character positions in the associated data item"; 2023: "fixed-length data item, literal, or intermediate result ... equal either to 1 or to the number of character positions ... whichever is greater". Same repeat-and-truncate rule, but 2023 adds cases (literals, intermediate results), limits it to fixed-length items, and keeps at least one character.
